correctness.rationale: Exact first-node 3x3 rank-one spiked estimator is 3 log(1+α(ε·u)^2), with α=θ/3. Sign-pair product P=((1+α)^2−4α²q)^2+64α³r, q=sum xixj, r=prod xi, xi=ui². At fixed q>1/4 minimizing r gives two equal larger coordinates; P(z) derivative 4α²(3z−1)(1+αz)(3αz−2α+1) has no interior minimum. Endpoints P2=(1+2α)^2 and P3=(1+α/3)^3(1+3α) cross only at θ*=5√10−14; q<=1/4 already bounded by P2. Jensen gives axis-only maximum 3log(1+α) and strictly positive expected logdet bias. Independently checked symbolic four-sign identity and derivative/endpoints plus 1200 rational/real orientation checks; analytic proof handles continuum.
